steps.headline: Soft and press, tuned — does it feel right now?
steps.changed: Your two picks are now the only behaviour: the switch happens on press, names open over 260ms on a plain ease, the badge opens after the name. Two things were making it feel rough: the badge was being cut off mid-opening because the timing window was tuned to the old speed, and the dots stepping aside were starting slowly, leaving the dragged pill over a dot. The dots now lead on the fast curve while everything that opens uses the gentle one.
steps.notice: Names open a touch slower than before. The badge finishes opening every time. Dragging feels the same as it did at the faster speed.
steps.risk: If something still feels off, say what gesture — click, hover, drag or drop — in the note.

steps.headline: How should the conversation arrive?
steps.risk: The conversation you are leaving is never animated. One element moves, so a very long conversation costs no more than a short one. The bounce here is on movement only; nothing in the strip bounces.

variants.label: Fade and lift
variants.summary: The baseline: fades in while rising 6px on the plain ease, 300ms.

variants.label: Spring up
variants.summary: Rises 14px and overshoots a touch before settling, while fading in. 380ms.

variants.label: Grow in
variants.summary: Starts a hair smaller and springs to size while fading in. No lift. 360ms.

variants.label: Slide in
variants.summary: Comes in from the right by 32px with a soft overshoot, like the next page of something. 360ms.
